source_evidence: Determine your time horizon by choosing the amount of time you dedicate to reaching your goal.
answer: Your investment time horizon is how long you expect to invest before using the money for a goal. For example, money invested for retirement decades away has a long-term horizon. Knowing your horizon can help you define your investing goals and, together with your risk tolerance, consider what types of investments may be appropriate. A longer horizon does not remove investment risk: investments can still fluctuate in value.
